items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1961-01-29
items.q: Mr. Crawford Ellis, I believe he was president of something like that. He was the one that got Peter on the band.

ctx.x: Yeah, he was arranging for the band. And in the band I remember well, there was Peter On the Leader, a violin player. The sax section was Arthur Durbin, Elliot Taylor, and Joe Ruzon. Elliot Taylor played Clannett in sax at that time. It was very good. I think Arthur Durbin was the first sax and he did a little singing. And in the rhythm section were Alla Greta on piano. He was very young. He was one of the young fellas. And Alfred William was on drums, Simon Moreau on bass, and me on banjo. I was playing banjo…

items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1959-01-17
items.q: Anything that was out there, he was a house band because they had a man named Mr. Crawford Ellis. That's the man that's got interest in Boat Young... And he liked the Peter Hone band.

ctx.x: Yeah, I didn't get that. Alfred William on drum. drums. So Peter Hone had nice work like the field work like it is now playing like at the New Orleans Country Club. He had that tied up. Anything that was out there, he was a house band because they had a man named Mr. Crawford Ellis. That's the man that's got interest in Boat Young, a little bit around the South American and the Pan American insurance. And he liked the Peter Hone band.
